job.purpose: q13-cdcw: hardened slot-shaped view for the Qwen3-8B ROM TP8 die cell qkd_cdc_wleaf (KV write-side CDC leaf, 128 instances; contract v3 slot cdc_EN_0). RTL = ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc MARGIN 1 / LCRED 6 / SYNC 2 / RSEL 1 / RNG 10 (the closed qfd_cdc_eco_h1 structure: TT +46.9 / FF +1.2 / DRC 0, no structural timing defect) under the cell-name wrapper qkd_cdc_wleaf; reference tile flow, 183.6 x 183.6, M5 cap (PG M5, strap M6, pins M4 W/E, M5 N/S), faces per the slot (co W, hi + clk N, ho E, wi/wr/cf S, hclk + resets W); two clock roots core clk 833.333 ps + hclk 1,024 ps with the old kit's crossing constraints (max-delay datapath budget both ways, no clock groups, no false paths) and per-domain boundary 0.2 T; inhold + outhold deterministic IO hold stages; TT/FF/SS view export
